Discover Silver SeedProfessional enquiries
01 / THE PLATFORM

Silver that starts with the surface.

Silver Seed is built around the controlled formation of a reflective silver surface over a prepared substrate. The result is a visual finish designed to capture light, form and detail.

The technology is presented publicly at a high level. Proprietary formulations, exact ratios and process parameters are intentionally not disclosed.

A platform for creative finishing — not simply a metallic paint.
02 / THE SILVER SEED FAMILY

One platform. Multiple directions.

AgCu Seed™

Silver and copper-inspired colour direction for distinctive metallic effects.

Silver Kinetics

A visual language for the controlled growth and development of reflective silver.

AgAu Seed™

A premium gold-toned direction within the wider Silver Seed concept family.

Made for objects that deserve attention.
